verdict: Spend is active and conversions are real — but lead tracking needs repair.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaigns spent $1,687.76 and recorded 16 conversions, and your Google Business Profile generated 110 actions including 41 calls — so demand is present. However, the paid funnel is showing zero leads tracked, which traces to a disconnect between the ad platform and your CRM, not a drop in interest from customers. We're repairing that connection so conversions flow through correctly and cost per lead can be reported accurately next period. Google Business Profile engagement fell sharply in the most recent week, which we're monitoring closely heading into the pre-heating-season window. Several planned items — including the Review Boost campaign, Homer Glen branch page, and financing page — are on track to go live by August 31.

highlights.phrase: calls from your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days
conversions recorded by Google Ads this period despite tracking gap
drop in Google Business Profile engagement week over week — being watched

watch_item.issue: Lead tracking is showing zero in the paid funnel due to a CRM and ad platform disconnect — conversions are happening but not flowing through to reportable leads.
watch_item.fix: The tracking connection is being repaired so that all conversions register as leads in your CRM; accurate cost-per-lead reporting resumes once this is confirmed.
